title: Systematic identification and characterization of exon-intron circRNAs
model: HEK293 EIciGFP reporter lines (P-In/EIciPAIP2, E-In/EIciEIF3J), genome-wide Brunello knockout library
contrast: High-GFP vs input, each reporter (1 vs 1, no replicates)
paper_method: MAGeCK RRA (positive selection; no gene_summary table deposited)
paper_calls: 854 (P-In) and 709 (E-In) high-GFP candidate genes, 80 shared; eight RNA-splicing RBPs (SRSF1, SRSF2, HNRNPK, SNRNP70 named); SRSF1 validated by shRNA knockdown
barcs_calls: 0 genes at FDR 0.10 (P-In), 25 (E-In); SRSF1 enriched in both but not significant, ranked #239/19,112 (E-In) and #2911/19,111 (P-In)
named_hits: SRSF1 recovered as enriched in both reporters, top 1.3% in E-In but mid-pack in P-In; SRSF2/HNRNPK/SNRNP70 rank low
verdict: BARCS recovers the paper's only validated hit SRSF1 as enriched in both reporters (and near the top 1% in E-In) but, with one library per sort and a large overdispersion, calls it at neither FDR 0.10 and does not support MAGeCK's 700-850-gene candidate lists; directions agree, significance does not.
